findings.detail: Actual generator uses bounded linear age/sex/uniform factors plus an independent Bernoulli-lognormal nonnegative excess. All required first/second and cross moments exist. Independent signed-extrema checks match every stored lower bound; the target BMI/glucose/HbA1c lower bounds are 17.103117092752044, 3.6293586047389104 and 4.602551031016875 respectively. No clipping, redraw, row deletion, local fitting or file I/O appears in generation.

The retained loading-map derivation corresponds term by term to the generator family. Independent scalar residualization yields separate Jansen BMI=0.13 and glucose=2.29 projections. They are not pasted as two coefficients of one joint equation. Both actual target residual-response slopes equal the derived Jansen structural slopes times 0.09148; the shared residual covariance is an explicit assumption. Source scenarios and target parameters differ and are not mislabelled as one empirical population.

Jansen source FPG upper bound is 6.264179564514795 mmol/L, below 7 without filtering. Its already-selected law has declared source eligibility, age law and measurement roles. Source selection, unknown weights, exact rows and assay transport are not reconstructed. Target/Bao nonnegative excess weights preserve the positivity proof.

Independent scalar covariance arithmetic reproduces Bao Pearson 0.7354295110342083, leaving the disclosed +0.11642951103420829 discrepancy from 0.619. This is an analytic check, not a fitted constraint. MIND Spearman remains contextual because its imputation/tie law is unidentified. These are not readiness failures or grounds for target-directed correction.

Target age/female effects, composition, marginal baselines, bounded-factor family, residual covariance and latent excess prevalence/scale are declared assumptions. The fully adjusted age result is algebraically implied by those choices, not established by external evidence. Exact Jansen source agreement was imposed and is not independent validation.
The committed final decision retains the unchanged frozen initial candidate after its own trial feedback and requests no second exploratory attempt. No scientific revision improvement is claimed.

Individual dispersion is separated from external estimator, structural and transport uncertainty. Seed variation represents draws of a fixed law; it does not integrate the other uncertainty components or establish clinical/inferential validity.

Review inspected code, frozen metadata, deterministic analytic artifacts and the permitted generated-summary feedback. It did not import or execute the generator/fitter, create rows or read target reports/patient records. Source replay is unavailable. Author access compliance remains a retained-provenance claim under procedural host isolation.

review_method: Static code-to-law inspection, immutable-byte checks, independent closed-form scalar moment/projection/support arithmetic only; no fitter/generator invocation or target-quality threshold
mathematical_notes: Finite-sample designs can fail rank despite population identifiability; floating-point overflow remains a charged execution failure, never justification for hidden clipping or redraw.
scope: Readiness for the fixed three final seeds, not empirical validity, favorable source fit or target usefulness.
